caption: The drawing features a single, vertically oriented ornamental object centered on a plain beige background. The object is predominantly green with intricate decorative patterns and accents in brownish-gold tones. Its shape is elongated with symmetrical, ornate filigree edges and pointed ends at the top and bottom, and has a central circular area. Within this central circle, there is a medallion-like portrait featuring a bust of a person in profile, done in brown tones. Below the object, printed in small, uppercase, thin black letters, is the name "HELEN BRONSON." There are no other objects or decorations on the page.
title: Drawer Pull
